description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class 'AbstractSubscriptionEvent' for subscription events within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides common properties and methods for handling subscription events, such as event type, subscription ID, headers, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: AbstractSubscriptionEvent
classes.description: An immutable abstract base class for subscription events, providing common fields and methods for event type, subscription ID, headers, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the subscription ID associated with this event.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the event.

methods.name: getRevision
methods.description: Returns the revision number of the event; always 0 for subscription events.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns this instance without changing revision, as revision is not applicable.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns a dummy entity ID as subscription events are not linked to a specific entity.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as subscription events have no timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an empty Optional as subscription events do not carry metadata.

methods.name: getDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns the headers associated with the event.

methods.name: getManifest
methods.description: Returns the event type as the manifest string.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the event to a JsonObject according to a schema and predicate.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to append event-specific payload during JSON serialization.
